verdict.rationale: Parsec is an account-based service with team configuration and audit logs, so data portability is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence documents a way to export all user data in open formats. The Teams API's audit-log and reporting access is a related feature for automation, not a documented full-data export, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
